page_title: Quarterly Access Review Pack (10 business days)
meta_description: Done-for-you quarterly user access reviews (SOC2/ISO-ready) for lean SaaS teams. Inventory, approvals, and an auditor-ready evidence pack.
for_whom: For 10–200 person B2B SaaS teams pursuing SOC2/ISO or selling into enterprise
hero_headline: Quarterly access reviews done-for-you (without the spreadsheet panic)
hero_subheadline: We pull access lists from your core tools, flag risky access, route approvals, and deliver an auditor-ready evidence pack in 10 business days.
secondary_cta_text: Request a redacted sample evidence pack
credibility_line: Least-privilege by default. Read-only exports. NDA-friendly. You approve every access change.
pain_paragraph: Access reviews are ‘simple’ until quarter-end: admins scramble for exports, nobody trusts who still has admin, and evidence is inconsistent when a customer or auditor asks. We turn it into a repeatable, defensible workflow.
before: Quarter-end spreadsheet scramble across Slack, Google Drive, and screenshots
No clean answer to: who has admin, why, and when was it last reviewed?
Ex-employees and inactive accounts linger with elevated access
Evidence is hard to audit (and takes days of engineer time)
after: Clean access inventory per system with role mapping
Risk flags (orphaned admins, inactive users, shared accounts)
Auditor-ready evidence pack + change log + retention policy
offer_summary: A quarterly ‘access review pack’ you can hand to auditors and enterprise customers: inventory, decisions, and evidence — delivered fast with minimal burden on your team.
included: Supported tool exports (pick 5–8): Google Workspace, GitHub, Slack, Jira, AWS IAM, GCP IAM, Okta, Datadog (and more by request)
Access inventory + role mapping (admin vs standard vs service accounts)
Anomaly detection (inactive users, ex-employees, duplicate identities, orphaned admins)
Approval routing spreadsheet/workflow: keep / remove / downgrade + owner sign-off
Deliverable: evidence pack (PDF/Doc + exports) + change log + reviewer attestation
excluded: Redesigning your IAM architecture (we can scope as a separate project)
Continuous monitoring/alerting (available as an add-on after the first review)
process: 15-min fit call: confirm systems, volume, and compliance requirements
Onboarding (week 1): access + export setup, naming conventions, reviewer list, and retention policy
Review run (10 business days): export → normalize → flag risks → route approvals
Deliver: evidence pack + remediation suggestions + next-quarter checklist
pricing_details: Starter includes up to 8 systems and up to 500 identities across those systems. Extra systems: $150 each per review. One-off option: $2,000 per quarterly review.
guarantee_line: Time-box guarantee: if we miss 10 business days (once exports are provided), you get 20% off that review.

faq.a: We prefer read-only exports (CSV/PDF) from each system, provided by your admins, into a dedicated folder. If needed, we can use delegated admin access with least privilege and an access log. No production credentials required.

faq.q: What are the prerequisites for a smooth review?
faq.a: A clear owner per system, a list of current employees/contractors, and a decision-maker who can approve removals/downgrades. If you have SSO/IdP (Okta/Google), even better.

faq.q: How does onboarding work and how long does it take?
faq.a: Onboarding is usually 60–90 minutes total across 1–2 calls. We set up the export checklist, folder structure, reviewer list, and approval workflow so future quarters are repeatable.

faq.q: Do you remove access for us?
faq.a: Only if you choose an ‘assisted remediation’ add-on and only after explicit written approval per change. By default, we provide a prioritized remediation list and you execute the changes.

Default is 30 days after delivery for working files, with a customer-controlled ‘evidence archive’ stored in your own Drive. We can shorten retention to 0 days (delete immediately after delivery) on request.

trust_basics_line: Not legal advice. You remain the source of truth for access and approvals; we operate the workflow and produce defensible documentation.
